digest.component_or_area: plan-review & code-review documentation and CLI/MCP explain interface
propositions: Authors cannot easily discover how to write a plan that passes the plan-review gate; existing material is either gate-mechanics focused or reviewer-centric criterion registry.
The code-review gate (LLM-Review + Verified) lacks a parallel author-facing on-ramp, and AGENTS.md misdirects authors to the criterion registry for the description template.
The CLI and MCP explain interface must support author guide names (rebar explain plan / rebar explain review) via a shared registry lookup.
New hand-written prose docs must be discoverable from CLI/MCP while remaining distinct from the generated criterion registry to preserve it as the single source of truth for reviewers.
docs/README.md and AGENTS.md must be updated to link and reference the new on-ramp docs; all top-level docs must be indexed to satisfy the docs-index CI gate.
